def_en: 1) who?, whose?, whom?, would that, whoever, whosoever
kjv: any (man), [idiom] he, [idiom] him, [phrase] O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), [phrase] would to God.
expl: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
etim: an interrogative pronoun of persons, as is of things,
